thread:
lia_design: quick design prompt — considering a left-band required indicator (a 4px colored bar along the left of the field) instead of an asterisk. saves horizontal space and stays visible when labels wrap. thoughts?
ben_frontend: interesting. pros: compact, consistent across sizes. cons: color-only signal might fail a11y and be missed with high-contrast themes
ada_a11y: (ada_a11y): agree with ben
—left-band can work if combined with programmatic cue. must use `aria-required="true"` and add visually hidden text `\u003cspan class=\"sr-only\"\u003eRequired\u003c/span\u003e` tied to the control
lia_design: good call. also thinking of an optional hover affordance that expands a small label "Required" without affecting layout (absolute overlay)
ben_frontend: implementation note: left-band as pseudo-element (`::before`) is easy and avoids extra DOM nodes. make it keyboard-targetable via `button` trigger for tooltip so keyboard users can reveal reason
ryan_pm: product note  some fields are conditionally required based on org plan. prefer reason in tooltip only when conditional, otherwise keep the band minimal to avoid noise
ada_a11y: tooltip must be reachable by keyboard and referenced by `aria-describedby`. if the reason contains links, open them in a new tab and mark `rel="noopener"` for security. announce tooltip opening with a short `aria-live` message
lia_design: new topic  delete gating for projects: currently modal is simple. propose policy-based gating: if project has >3 active deployments OR flagged prod -> require typed project slug; else show destructive CTA + undo toast (10s).
ben_frontend: can do. we'll add server-side flag `requires_typed_confirm` in response and client shows corresponding modal. also include a short consequences list in modal body (snapshots, team webhooks, billing impacts)
ryan_pm: agree on risk-based gating. add graceful fallback: if typed confirm fails repeatedly, fall back to a support flow instead of blocking forever
ada_a11y: typed confirm accessibility: focus the input on modal open, label the input clearly (e.g., "Type the project slug to confirm"), `autocomplete="off"`, and provide `aria-live` for mismatch errors. consider a secondary confirmation method for assistive tech users (consult with research)
lia_design: one more practical item  error display strategy: inline messages under fields for single errors; group banner only for cross-field or server-side errors with anchors — banner should say e.g., "2 problems need your attention" and link to fields
ben_frontend: dev checklist: set `aria-invalid` on invalid controls, unique error `id`s for aria-describedby, auto-focus first invalid field on submit, and ensure error anchor links `element.focus()`
infra-bot: Heads-up: design-token `indicator-contrast` will be rotated at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. check new value against AA/AAA as needed.
lia_design: thanks all  i'll mock left-band + overlay reveal and both modal variants (typed confirm + CTA+undo) and post in thread for review :sparkles:
